text:
**Can I export my data from the app?**

Yes. You can export your transactions as CSV or JSON. CSV opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers, and JSON is useful if you want to bring your data into other apps or tools.

Exports are quick: 10,000 transactions take less than 2 minutes.

Exporting is included on the free plan, so you don't need to upgrade to get your own records. That covers switching to another budgeting tool, keeping a backup of your history, or digging into your spending in a spreadsheet.
